_note: Gratuity received under the gratuity statute: deducted up to the amount that statute entitles (D-109; rulebook RET-GRAT-PGA-001). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.19(1) Table Sl. 5 (p.41), "Gratuity received under the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972 (39 of 1972). — Amount received, as restricted to the amount calculated as per the provisions of section 4(2) and (3) of the said Act." TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.10(10)(ii) (thc.nic.in p.71), "any gratuity received under the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972 (39 of 1972), to the extent it does not exceed an amount calculated in accordance with the provisions of sub-sections (2) and (3) of section 4 of that Act". That Act was repealed on 21-11-2025 (Code on Social Security, 2020 s.164(1) item 6; S.O. 5319(E)); the reference is read as the Code's s.53(2)–(3) for a separation on or after that day (D-107) — the same fifteen days' wages per completed year or part over six months, monthly rate ÷ 26 × 15, but on the Code's wage, which adds back allowances above one-half of remuneration (s.2(88)). The amount is the employer's figure under the Act in force on the separation day (StatutoryEntitlement); it already includes s.4(3)'s / s.53(3)'s ceiling, which is therefore not seeded (S.O. 1420(E), 29-3-2018, not read). Every regime (s.202(2)(a); s.115BAC(2)(i)).

introducedBy.instrumentCitation: Finance Act, 2023 (8 of 2023), s.52 — the new regime of s.115BAC(1A), whose s.115BAC(2)(i) does not exclude s.10(10), so the entry applies in every regime

provenance.sourceDescription: Income-tax Act, 1961 as on thc.nic.in (current to Act 7 of 2019), s.10(10)(ii), p.71; the labour statutes and their repeal: sources/2026-09-27-retirement-limits.md; s.10(10)(ii): the amending Acts F(No.2)A 2019, TLA 2019, FA 2020, TOLA 2020, FA 2021–2023, the interim FA 2024, F(No.2)A 2024, FA 2025, TLA 2025 and FA 2026 are read and none amends it (docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-10-act-chain-2019-2026.md); the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972, repealed on 21-11-2025 by the Code on Social Security, 2020 s.164(1) item 6 (S.O. 5319(E), CG-DL-E-21112025-267882), is re-enacted with modification by the Code's s.53(2)–(3), so by the General Clauses Act, 1897 s.8(1) ("references in any other enactment … to the provision so repealed shall, unless a different intention appears, be construed as references to the provision so re-enacted"; thc.nic.in copy, p.18) the reference reads as s.53(2)–(3) for a separation on or after that day (D-107); no CBDT clarification found (sources/2026-09-27-retirement-limits.md C5) (docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-11-groups-c-e.md)
